about: Sainte-Catherine is a South Shore city in Montérégie, on the St. Lawrence River opposite Montréal near the Kahnawà:ke Mohawk Territory and the Honoré-Mercier Bridge approaches. Riverside parks, a marina, and suburban neighbourhoods define a compact riverside municipality. About 17,000 people live in Sainte-Catherine.
seoSummary: South Shore city on the St. Lawrence near Kahnawà:ke, with riverside parks and marina.
